# 111. Det stora sveket, hjärtsvikt och fastighetsfest i Båstad

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-07-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode 111 of Börssurr centres on the Swedish real-estate sector after the Kapitalmarknadsdagarna conference in Båstad, debating whether the sector's optimism and buyback/asset-sale trend (led by Castellum) is a genuine turn or short-lived, with hosts noting the market can only focus on one theme at a time and has rotated away from both AI and property. Other threads: Bahnhof's 'betrayal' sale to Telenor, AstraZeneca's ~9% drop on a failed heart-failure trial, macro fatigue around recurring Iran/oil scares, and speculation on 'chipflation' vs AI-driven disinflation. Overall mood is cautiously mixed — more optimistic on real estate but sceptical of conviction.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 THULE — Thule Group | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Well-run, high-margin firm down ~26% to ~201kr; hosts explicitly say viewers should look more at it as it gets cheaper.

#### Reasoning

Hosts frame Thule as a quality, high-margin company whose stock has been beaten down (~300 to ~201kr) partly due to Thule family issues, not fundamentals. They note little Swedish-consumer exposure and that US/Swedish consumers are doing better than sentiment surveys suggest, which could support Thule. They stop short of a firm buy, urging closer study.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins compress further
- if US consumer demand weakens
- if Thule family/ownership overhang worsens

> *"Ni, alla som tittar och lyssnar, ska nog titta lite mer på Thule. Det är ett välskött, fint bolag."*

---

### 🟡 SAGA-B — Sagax | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host owns Sagax D-share since IPO for a safe ~6-7% dividend, not price upside; common stock down 25-30% after emission and French bus-depot purchase.

#### Reasoning

Host is explicit he holds the Sagax D-share purely for its reliable ~6-7% dividend, which he considers very safe, not for capital gains. He warns you won't get rich on it. The ordinary share is down 25-30% over a year and made a large ~2bn French bus-depot acquisition after an emission, raising questions on capital use.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the dividend is cut
- if balance sheet deteriorates
- if acquisitions dilute returns

> *"Jag har varit väldigt tydlig under många år att jag äger den och har ägt den sedan den kom ut... det är bara att jag tycker att det är väldigt trevligt att få en utdelning."*

---

### 🟡 CAST — Castellum | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Everyone loves Castellum (up ~20%, sells assets and buys back stock); analysts hold buy but hosts suspect the run may be over and the strategy is too defensive.

#### Reasoning

Castellum is outperforming (up ~20% vs peers down ~10%) by selling assets, buying back shares and paying out. Analysts around Båstad still hold buy ratings, but hosts question whether 'the race is run' — the defensive sell-and-distribute model shrinks the portfolio and may have picked the low-hanging fruit, so upside from here is doubted.

#### Sell Triggers

- if asset sales dry up
- if buyback capacity is exhausted
- if it can't reinvest to grow the portfolio

> *"Kastellum kanske är loppet i sprunget för Kastellum och sånt där får man ju alltid ångra när man säger."*

---

### 🟢 WIHL — Wihlborgs | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Crowd and a host's contact favour 'team Wihlborg'; regionally focused southern-Sweden specialist that is expanding and may be rewarded for shopping/visionary growth.

#### Reasoning

The Båstad crowd emotionally preferred Wihlborgs over Castellum because it expands and builds its portfolio rather than shrinking it. It is a disciplined southern-Sweden specialist (low risk of random overseas deals) that can refine acquired assets. Hosts argue that while sellers are rewarded now, a visionary buyer like Wihlborgs will eventually be rewarded — but conviction is soft.

#### Sell Triggers

- if financing costs rise sharply
- if acquisitions destroy value
- if it strays outside its home region

> *"Han tyckte att Vilborg gör det så bra för att de är koncentrerade kring en region."*
